tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Top stripe and the primary accent: primary button fill, the 3px selection bar, the composer's Send button. Never text, never a text ground for anything but `on-stripe`.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Middle stripe. Primary button hover fill, highlights, and the source of `focus-glow`. Never text on cream (1.5:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Bottom stripe only. Not for text or fills anywhere else.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill only. Not a stripe color: red beside orange and yellow reads as a flag on dark.

tokens.name: on-stripe
tokens.usage: Text and borders on an `orange`, `yellow` or `teal` fill, in both themes (light ink, never white). 5.6:1 on light orange, 6.4:1 on dark orange.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: App background (dark theme calls it Night). Agent replies sit directly on it.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, the composer, dialogs. Also the text color on the `red` destructive fill.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Sidebar and code blocks.

tokens.name: sand-deep
tokens.usage: User message blocks only: a faint step off `cream`. `ink` reads 11.5:1 on it (light), 11.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and resting borders on cards and inputs. Decorative: it does not meet 3:1, so never use it as the only sign that something is clickable.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and every interactive border (1.5 to 2px). 13.7:1 on cream light, 14.4:1 dark; at least 11.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, small text and labels on `cream`, `paper` and `sand` (4.8:1 or better, both themes). 4.4:1 on light `sand-deep`: keep it off user messages.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, weight 600. 5.6:1 on cream light, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done / success dot. Status dots sit beside an `ink` word, so the color is a mark, not text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting / warning dot. Light value is 2.9:1 on cream, just under the 3:1 mark floor: always pair it with the word.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failed / error dot and error text (same value as `link`). 5.6:1 on cream light, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-glow
tokens.usage: The 3px focus glow around a focused input, outside its `ink` border: `yellow` at 55% opacity. The `ink` border carries the contrast; the glow is the brand cue.

tokens.name: mark-field
tokens.usage: The mark's circle. Fixed light `orange` in both themes: the mark never changes with the theme.

tokens.name: mark-bird
tokens.usage: The mark's bird. Fixed light `paper`, never pure white.

tokens.name: mark-cap
tokens.usage: The mark's cap. Fixed light `ink`, never pure black.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only: always lowercase `tern`, Archivo 900 italic at 125% width, tracking -0.03em. Size is free; 34px is the lockup size on the style sheet.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and section titles, big numbers. Sentence case. The guide asks for 112 to 125% width; the bundled files are the 125% cut.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reconciled 38 of 41 transactions. Three need a human look.
styles.usage: Running text, messages, list rows, in `ink`. Use 700 for emphasis.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case, a verb.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: The word after a status dot, in `ink`. No uppercase. The app bundles no 500 weight, so it renders at 400 there.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Timestamps, metadata and help text, in `muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and group labels, sentence case, in `muted`. Never uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands and tool calls, on `sand`. 12/1.4 is the desktop app's value; the guide gives no size.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: DEFAULT. Hairline gaps: icon to label inside a control.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its word (style sheet).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: DEFAULT. Tight gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; vertical padding of inputs and the composer (style sheet).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between messages; horizontal padding of inputs and the composer (style sheet).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Message side padding, so user blocks and agent replies share a text edge (guide).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Padding of the chat column and the topbar (style sheet).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding (style sheet).

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Space between major page sections (style sheet). Leave generous empty space.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: DEFAULT from the style sheet: small things inside a container, such as sidebar rows and the Send chip in the composer.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, user message blocks, code blocks, tooltips (guide).

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The composer only (guide).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and bubbles (guide).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only (guide).

stroke.note: Border and bar widths. Hairline at rest; ink at 1.5 to 2px means you can click this.

tokens.name: border-rest
tokens.usage: `hairline` borders on cards and dividers at rest.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Input border (`hairline` at rest, `ink` on focus) and the composer's `ink` border.

tokens.name: border-interactive
tokens.usage: `ink` border on buttons and anything active.

tokens.name: selection-bar
tokens.usage: The `orange` bar on the left edge of a selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: focus-glow-width
tokens.usage: Spread of the `focus-glow` ring around a focused input.

stripe.note: The racing stripe: orange, yellow, teal, hard-edged, no gaps, never reordered. At most one stripe element per view.

tokens.name: stripe-edge
tokens.usage: Bar thickness for the page-edge stripe at the top of a window or page (guide: 6 to 8px).

tokens.name: stripe-slant
tokens.usage: Bar thickness for the slanted hero / empty-state stripe (guide: 12 to 14px).

tokens.name: stripe-small
tokens.usage: Bar thickness for the small slanted divider (guide: 3 to 4px).

tokens.name: stripe-vertical
tokens.usage: Bar width for a vertical stripe used as a side tab or divider (guide).

tokens.name: stripe-skew
tokens.usage: Skew for the slanted stripe variants (guide).
